posts.text: I put GPT-6.2 Sol through some heavy testing today. It’s okay for simple tasks, but on more complex coding tasks, it’s not just a little worse than Opus 5.5—Opus 5.5 still has to clean up its mess afterward. It would be better to just have Opus 5.5 do the work from the start.
posts.quoted: Seeing a lot of tweets saying GPT-6.2 is bad. Not sure if it’s really that bad or if Anthropic paid for it

Lauren Tan wrote a beginner’s guide to automation. The core idea is: first make the goal clear, then teach the bot how to do it.

Here’s one way I differ from her.

Lauren is very capable herself, and the Grok model may not be smart enough yet, so she puts more effort into
posts.quoted: I think a lot of people aren't using Grok Bot to its full potential, because knowing how to automate things is actually quite a difficult skill to learn. I wrote this post to break down how I approach automating anything with Grok Bot!
